items.title: The delta-invariant of a reduced one-dimensional Nagata local ring is unchanged by henselization, strict henselization and completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the delta-invariant of a reduced one-dimensional Nagata local ring agrees with that of its henselization, strict henselization and completion. The proof carries out the completion case and notes that the other two go the same way: it lets A' and B' be the integral closures of A and of B = A^ in their total rings of fractions, uses the normalization-and-completion lemma to identify B' = A' tensor_A B, and rewrites B'/B = (A'/A) tensor_A B (proof lines 8434-8440). The equality of lengths then follows from the pullback module lemma together with the identification B tensor_A kappa_A = kappa_B (proof lines 8441-8443). H2: the base change identification of the integral closures and the length comparison are the substance.
